crime.skycraft.jail.escaped_seen: The guards saw you go! Bounty added.
crime.skycraft.jail.escaped_unseen: You slipped away unseen - but the escape is on record. Bounty added.
crime.skycraft.jail.kept_picks: You managed to keep %s lockpick(s) concealed in your boot.
crime.skycraft.jail.labour: You haul a load of silver ore. Time left: %s
crime.skycraft.jail.mine_labour: Work the silver veins with your pickaxe: each load takes %s seconds off your sentence.
crime.skycraft.jail.too_soon: You must serve at least a minute of your sentence before resting (%ss to go).
crime.skycraft.jail.vein_worked: This vein is worked out for now.
dialogue.skycraft.faction.amends: I want to make amends. (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.faction.benefits: What does the %s offer its members?
dialogue.skycraft.faction.pull: As %s of the %s, I ask you to overlook this.
dialogue.skycraft.faction.rank: How do I rise in the %s?
faction.skycraft.aldmeri_dominion.benefi: Servants train archery and magic with the envoys, buy general and arcane goods for less, sleep in the halls and receive an elven dagger, elven armour and, at the last, gilded elven armour; Summerset's and Valenwood's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.aldmeri_dominion.desc: The alliance of the Altmer, Bosmer and Khajiit under the throne of Alinor, which means to restore the Merethic order to Tamriel.
faction.skycraft.aldmeri_dominion.join: Altmer, Bosmer and Khajiit may serve: speak with the Queen's envoy in Firsthold or Alinor. Blades and Stormcloaks are enemies of the Dominion.
faction.skycraft.arena.benefits: Combatants train with the Arena's masters, buy arms for less in the Bloodworks, sleep there between bouts and earn the Arena's raiment, gladiator armour and, at the last, the Grand Champion's axe.
faction.skycraft.arena.desc: The great Arena of the Imperial City, where combatants fight for coin and glory before the roaring crowd, rank by rank up to the Grand Champion.
faction.skycraft.arena.halls: The Bloodworks beside the Arena, Imperial City.
faction.skycraft.arena.join: Speak with the Blademaster at the Bloodworks beside the Arena in the Imperial City.
faction.skycraft.ashlanders.benefits: Clanfriends learn archery and hunting from the hunters, trade pelts and exotic goods for less, sleep in the yurts and receive a chitin bow, chitin armour and, at the last, the Ashkhan's spear.
faction.skycraft.ashlanders.desc: The nomad tribes of the Dunmer, who never left the old ways for the Great Houses or the Temple. They follow the guar herds across the ashlands and honour their ancestors and their wise women.
faction.skycraft.ashlanders.halls: The trading camp outside Ald'ruhn; the Urshilaku camp in the north of Vvardenfell.
faction.skycraft.ashlanders.join: Visit the Ashlander trading camp outside Ald'ruhn, or the Urshilaku camp, and earn the clan's trust.
faction.skycraft.bards_college.benefits: Students learn speech and lore from the masters, buy books for less and are welcome to perform in every inn of Skyrim.
faction.skycraft.blades.benefits: Blades train blade and heavy armour with the Knight-Commanders, buy steel for less, rest at Cloud Ruler and receive an Akaviri tanto, Blades armour and, at the last, the Grandmaster's katana.
faction.skycraft.blades.desc: The Dragonguard of old, sworn to the Dragonborn and hunted to near extinction by the Thalmor. A few keep the watch at Cloud Ruler Temple still.
faction.skycraft.blades.halls: Cloud Ruler Temple above Bruma; Sky Haven Temple in the Reach.
faction.skycraft.blades.join: Seasoned warriors (level 10) may be invited at Cloud Ruler Temple, above Bruma. The Thalmor and the Dominion's servants are never welcome.
faction.skycraft.camonna_tong.benefits: Members train sneak and the blade with the gang, fence stolen goods, buy cheaply from its fence and receive a shiv, netch armour and, at the last, the boss's axe.
faction.skycraft.camonna_tong.desc: The criminal syndicate of Morrowind's natives: smuggling, skooma and murder, with a hatred of outlanders and friends high in House Hlaalu.
faction.skycraft.camonna_tong.join: Only Dunmer are welcome at the Council Club in Balmora. Thieves Guild rats and Company men need not ask.
faction.skycraft.college.benefits: Members study under the College's masters, buy spell tomes and staves for less, sleep in the Hall of Attainment and receive tomes and robes as they rise.
faction.skycraft.companions.benefits: Members train with the Circle (one- and two-handed, heavy armour, block), buy from Eorlund's forge at a discount, bed down in Jorrvaskr and earn Skyforge steel, a share of the contracts and, in time, the beast blood.
faction.skycraft.contract.desc.bandits: %s hired me to put an end to %s and the outlaws riding with them.
faction.skycraft.contract.desc.beasts: %s asked me to hunt down %s before it kills again.
faction.skycraft.contract.desc.necromanc: %s asked me to stop %s before more of the dead are raised.
faction.skycraft.contract.desc.undead: %s sent me to lay %s to rest, along with the dead that walk with it.
faction.skycraft.contract.desc.writ: %s gave me a quiet job: %s is to be dealt with, no questions asked.
faction.skycraft.contract.pitch.bandits: A contract for you: %s has been bleeding the roads dry. Their camp is %s. %s gold when it's done.
faction.skycraft.contract.pitch.beasts: %s has been taking herders %s. Hunt it for %s gold.
faction.skycraft.contract.pitch.necroman: %s has been digging up graves and worse. You'll find them %s. Stop them - %s gold.
faction.skycraft.contract.pitch.undead: The dead don't rest %s - %s walks there. Put it down for %s gold.
faction.skycraft.contract.pitch.writ: There's a name on a writ: %s. Last seen %s. %s gold, and keep it clean.
faction.skycraft.contract.title: %s Contract: %s
faction.skycraft.crowns.benefits: Members train the blade and heavy armour with Crown swordmasters, buy arms for less, sleep in the Crown halls and receive a scimitar, Ra Gada armour and, at the last, a shehai blade; the guards of the Alik'r and Craglorn defer to them.
faction.skycraft.crowns.desc: The traditionalist nobility of Hammerfell, keepers of the Yokudan ways, the sword-singers' memory and the High King's line.
faction.skycraft.crowns.halls: Crown halls in Sentinel and Skaven.
faction.skycraft.crowns.join: Speak with the Crown lord in Sentinel. A Forebear can never be trusted by the Crowns.
faction.skycraft.dark_brotherhood.benefi: Members take contracts for good gold (more for a quiet kill), buy poisons cheaply in the Sanctuary, rest there in safety and receive shrouded armour and the Blade of Woe.
faction.skycraft.dark_brotherhood.halls: The Dawnstar and Falkreath sanctuaries in Skyrim; the Cheydinhal sanctuary in Cyrodiil.
faction.skycraft.east_empire_company.ben: Company men train speech and archery with the factors, buy general and exotic goods for less, sleep in the offices and receive a factor's coat, an agent's cuirass and, at the last, the director's sabre; Ebonheart's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.east_empire_company.des: The Empire's great trading company: ships, warehouses, charters and the ebony mines of Solstheim, from Ebonheart to Solitude and Senchal.
faction.skycraft.east_empire_company.hal: Ebonheart (headquarters), Anvil, Raven Rock and Senchal.
faction.skycraft.east_empire_company.joi: Speak with the factor at the Company's offices in Ebonheart, Anvil, Raven Rock or Senchal. The Camonna Tong's men are not hired.
faction.skycraft.expelled_no: The %s have cast you out. Make amends at one of their halls first.
faction.skycraft.fighters_guild.benefits: Members train blade, heavy armour and block at every hall, buy from the quartermasters for less, sleep in the halls' bunks and earn the Guild's blade, signet, plate and, at the last, the Master's greatsword.
faction.skycraft.fighters_guild.desc: A guild of honest blades for hire, chartered by the Empire. It clears rats from cellars and bandits from roads, and it will not take a contract it cannot finish with its honour intact.
faction.skycraft.fighters_guild.halls: Chorrol (headquarters), Anvil, Bravil, Bruma, Cheydinhal, Leyawiin, Skingrad; Balmora and Ald'ruhn; Wayrest, Daggerfall and Sentinel.
faction.skycraft.fighters_guild.join: Speak with Vilena Donton at the Fighters Guild in Chorrol, or with any guild steward. Anyone willing to work is welcome.
faction.skycraft.forebears.benefits: Members train speech and the blade with the merchant captains, buy exotic goods for less, sleep in the halls and receive a signet, Ra Gada armour and, at the last, the Forebear lord's sabre; the guards of the coast defer to them.
faction.skycraft.forebears.desc: The cosmopolitan Redguards of the coast, who embraced Imperial trade and the newer ways, masters of Hammerfell's ports.
faction.skycraft.forebears.halls: Forebear halls in Taneth and Rihad.
faction.skycraft.forebears.join: Speak with the merchant-lord at the Forebear hall in Taneth. The Crowns' men are not welcome.
faction.skycraft.forsworn.benefits: Forsworn are left in peace by their kin, learn archery and hunting in their camps, trade with their hunters and wear Forsworn armour and, at the last, a briarheart's vest.
faction.skycraft.forsworn.desc: The Reachfolk who never bent the knee to Nords or Empire. Their hagravens make briarhearts of their bravest, and their king, Madanach, rots in Cidhna Mine.
faction.skycraft.forsworn.halls: Druadach Redoubt and the camps of the Reach.
faction.skycraft.forsworn.join: Only the King in Rags can make a Forsworn of an outsider - and he is locked in Cidhna Mine.
faction.skycraft.forsworn.rank.4: Hand of the King in Rags
faction.skycraft.green_pact.benefits: Wardens learn archery and hunting, trade pelts for less, rest in the warden halls and receive a warden's hood, Bosmeri armour and, at the last, the Bow of the Green; Valenwood's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.green_pact.desc: The Bosmer who keep Y'ffre's Green Pact - no plant may be harmed - and guard Valenwood's forests in the name of the Silvenar and the Green Lady.
faction.skycraft.green_pact.halls: Warden halls in Elden Root and Falinesti; the Silvenar's court in Malabal Tor.
faction.skycraft.green_pact.join: Speak with a Warden at Elden Root or Falinesti and swear to the Green Pact.
faction.skycraft.greybeards.benefits: Students receive the Greybeards' teaching and Words of Power, grey robes and, at the last, the robes of a Master of the Voice.
faction.skycraft.greybeards.desc: The Greybeards of High Hrothgar keep the Way of the Voice: the Thu'um is for worship and wisdom, not for war. They speak rarely, and when they do the mountain listens.
faction.skycraft.greybeards.halls: High Hrothgar on the Throat of the World.
faction.skycraft.greybeards.join: Answer the Greybeards' summons and complete "The Way of the Voice": they count all who walk the Way as their students.
faction.skycraft.house_hlaalu.benefits: Members train speech and sneak with the House's agents, buy from the House factor for less, sleep in the manor, and their word carries weight with the guards of the West Gash and the Ascadian Isles.
faction.skycraft.house_hlaalu.desc: The most worldly of the Great Houses of Morrowind: merchants, diplomats and friends of the Empire, ruling Balmora and the trade of the west. Its rivals call it corrupt, and are not always wrong.
faction.skycraft.house_hlaalu.halls: The Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora; the Hlaalu canton in Vivec.
faction.skycraft.house_hlaalu.join: Speak with Nileno Dorvayn at the Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora. A member of House Redoran or House Telvanni can never join.
faction.skycraft.house_redoran.benefits: Members train heavy armour and the blade with the House's champions, buy arms for less, sleep in the council hall and receive chitin, bonemold armour and, at the last, the Archmaster's spear - and the guards of the ashlands and Solstheim defer to them.
faction.skycraft.house_redoran.desc: The warrior House of Morrowind, keepers of duty, piety and honour, ruling the ashlands from Ald'ruhn. A Redoran's word is iron.
faction.skycraft.house_redoran.halls: The Redoran Council Hall in Ald'ruhn; Raven Rock on Solstheim.
faction.skycraft.house_redoran.join: Speak with Neminda at the Redoran Council Hall in Ald'ruhn. A member of House Hlaalu or House Telvanni can never join.
faction.skycraft.house_telvanni.benefits: Members study under the House's wizards, buy tomes and reagents for less, use the council house's enchanter, and receive Telvanni robes and, at the last, the Archmagister's dagger; the guards of Telvanni lands defer to them.
faction.skycraft.house_telvanni.desc: The House of wizard-lords who grow their towers from giant mushrooms and recognise no law but power. Among the Telvanni, the strong take what they want - politely, if possible.
faction.skycraft.house_telvanni.halls: The Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora; Tel Mithryn on Solstheim.
faction.skycraft.house_telvanni.join: Speak with the Mouth at the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora - but know some magic first (destruction, alteration, mysticism or conjuration at 15). Hlaalu and Redoran members are not welcome.
faction.skycraft.imperial_cult.benefits: The faithful keep a Divine's shrine blessing twice as long, learn restoration from the priests, buy remedies for less and receive the Cult's amulet, robes and, at the last, the Primate's amulet.
faction.skycraft.imperial_cult.blessing: Your faith is rewarded: the blessing will last twice as long.
faction.skycraft.imperial_cult.desc: The faith of the Eight and One, tended by the Primate at the Temple of the One. Its priests heal, bless and lay the restless dead, and its alms keep the poor of the Empire alive.
faction.skycraft.imperial_cult.halls: The Temple of the One in the Imperial City and the chapels of every city.
faction.skycraft.imperial_cult.join: Speak with Primate Artorius at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.
faction.skycraft.imperial_legion.benefit: Soldiers are armed and armoured by the Legion, train at its forges, buy from its quartermasters for less, and their word carries weight with the guards of Cyrodiil and of holds the Legion holds.
faction.skycraft.imperial_legion.halls: Castle Dour in Solitude; the Legion barracks in the Imperial City.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_dragon.b: Knights train heavy armour and the blade with the order's masters, buy arms for less, sleep in the hall and receive a dragon helm, plate and, at the last, the Lord Commander's blade; Glenumbra's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_dragon.d: The foremost knightly order of Daggerfall, sworn to its crown and to the slaying of dragons and monsters across Glenumbra.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_dragon.j: Speak with the Lord Commander at the order's hall in Daggerfall.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_nine.ben: Knights keep a Divine's shrine blessing twice as long, train with the Priory's knights and priests, buy steel for less and receive crusader plate and, at the last, the Mace of the Crusader.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_nine.des: A holy order reborn at the Priory of the Nine to recover the relics of Pelinal Whitestrake, the Divine Crusader, and to stand against the darkness he fought.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_nine.hal: The Priory of the Nine near Kvatch.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_nine.joi: Walk the pilgrimage of the Nine and speak with Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory of the Nine near Kvatch. No assassin of the Dark Brotherhood and no vampire may kneel there.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_rose.ben: Knights train heavy armour and the blade, buy arms for less, sleep in the hall and receive the Rose's surcoat, plate and, at the last, the Thorn of the Rose; the guards of Wayrest and Stormhaven defer to them.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_rose.des: The chivalric order of Wayrest, as famous for courtly grace as for its lances, sworn to protect the realm and its people.
faction.skycraft.knights_of_the_rose.joi: Speak with the Lord of the Rose at the order's hall in Wayrest.
faction.skycraft.mages_guild.benefits: Members study every school of magic in the halls, buy spell tomes and reagents for less, use the enchanters and alchemy labs, sleep in the halls and receive robes, tomes and, at the last, the Arch-Mage's staff.
faction.skycraft.mages_guild.desc: Tamriel's guild of magic, ruled from the Arcane University in the Imperial City. It studies, teaches and sells spells, and it does not forgive necromancers.
faction.skycraft.mages_guild.halls: The Arcane University in the Imperial City; halls in Anvil, Bravil, Bruma, Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin and Skingrad; Balmora, Ald'ruhn and Sadrith Mora; Wayrest, Daggerfall and Sentinel.
faction.skycraft.mages_guild.join: Speak with a guild steward in any city hall, then seek the halls' recommendations for the Arcane University.
faction.skycraft.moon_priests.benefits: Priests learn restoration and lore from the Moon-Bishops, buy remedies and arcane goods for less, rest in the temples and receive moon-white robes and, at the last, the Lunar Glaive; Torval's and Senchal's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.moon_priests.desc: The clergy of Elsweyr, who keep the Riddle'Thar and the Lunar Lattice and serve the Mane, the spiritual leader of the Khajiit.
faction.skycraft.moon_priests.join: Speak with the Moon-Bishop at the temple in Torval or Senchal. A Renrijra Krin will find no welcome.
faction.skycraft.morag_tong.benefits: Members train sneak and archery with the Tong's masters, buy blades for less, rest in the guildhalls and receive the Tong's hood, netch armour and, at the last, the Grandmaster's writ-blade.
faction.skycraft.morag_tong.desc: The ancient, legal assassins' guild of Morrowind, who kill only by sanctioned writ in the name of Mephala. They despise the Dark Brotherhood, their outcast kin.
faction.skycraft.morag_tong.halls: Guildhalls in Balmora, Ald'ruhn and Sadrith Mora; the Arena canton in Vivec.
faction.skycraft.morag_tong.join: Speak with the guild officer at the Morag Tong hall in Balmora. A member of the Dark Brotherhood would be killed, not hired.
faction.skycraft.orc_strongholds.benefit: Blood-Kin may enter every stronghold, train heavy armour and smithing with the forgemasters, buy orcish steel for less and receive an orcish axe, stronghold armour and, at the last, the Honored Chief's blade; Wrothgar's guards defer to them.
faction.skycraft.orc_strongholds.birthri: As an Orc, every stronghold counts you as Blood-Kin.
faction.skycraft.orc_strongholds.desc: The clans of the Orsimer, living by the Code of Malacath in their strongholds and in rebuilt Orsinium. To them every outsider is a stranger until the chief names them Blood-Kin.
faction.skycraft.orc_strongholds.halls: The Hall of the Clans in Orsinium; the strongholds of Skyrim: Dushnikh Yal, Mor Khazgur, Largashbur and Narzulbur.
faction.skycraft.orc_strongholds.join: Orsimer are Blood-Kin by birth. Others must win a chief's favour: help a stronghold such as Dushnikh Yal, or speak at the Hall of the Clans in Orsinium.
faction.skycraft.psijic_order.benefits: Psijics study under the Loremasters, learn mysticism and the Old Ways, and receive Psijic robes, rare tomes and, at the last, the Ritemaster's circlet.
faction.skycraft.psijic_order.desc: The oldest monastic order of Tamriel, keepers of the Old Way on the isle of Artaeum, who see further than other mages and act only when they must.
faction.skycraft.psijic_order.halls: The isle of Artaeum, off Summerset.
faction.skycraft.psijic_order.join: The Order finds you, not the other way round: master mysticism (25), or rise in the College of Winterhold or the Mages Guild, and a summons to Artaeum will come.
faction.skycraft.reason.kinslayer: You murdered one of your own.
faction.skycraft.renrijra_krin.benefits: Members train sneak and archery in the camp, fence their loot cheaply, sleep in the tents and receive a claw, Khajiiti armour and, at the last, the Warlord's claw.
faction.skycraft.renrijra_krin.desc: Khajiiti rebels and outlaws - the Laughing Fools - who raid nobles, Thalmor and caravans alike in the name of a free Elsweyr.
faction.skycraft.renrijra_krin.join: Find the Warlord's hidden camp outside Rimmen. The Moon-Priests' servants are not trusted.
faction.skycraft.reply.amends: The %s will take you back. Once. Remember that.
faction.skycraft.reply.amends_poor: Words are cheap. Come back with %s gold for the hall.
faction.skycraft.reply.next_rank: You are %s. Keep working: you'll be %s once you have %s of %s points of standing.
faction.skycraft.reply.pull_ok: Hmph. The %s vouch for you. Go on - and stay out of trouble.
faction.skycraft.reply.pull_too_much: Not even the %s can make this much trouble disappear. Pay or come quietly.
faction.skycraft.reply.pull_used: I already did you one favour today. Don't push it.
faction.skycraft.reply.rival: You stand with the %s. We have no place for you here.
faction.skycraft.reply.top_rank: You are %s. There is no higher rank to climb - only a reputation to keep.
faction.skycraft.reply.welcome: Then it's settled. Welcome to the %s. Don't make us regret it.
faction.skycraft.shadowscales.benefits: Shadowscales train sneak and restoration in the enclave, buy poisons and remedies for less, rest there and receive a Shadowscale mask, Argonian armour and, at the last, the Speaker's Fang; the guards of Black Marsh defer to them.
faction.skycraft.shadowscales.desc: Argonians hatched under the sign of the Shadow, given to the Hist and trained from the egg as the assassins and spies of the King of Argonia.
faction.skycraft.shadowscales.join: Only Argonians are taken into the enclave outside Stormhold. The Morag Tong are rivals of old.
faction.skycraft.silver_hand.benefits: None: they are the enemy of the Companions and of the Vigilants.
faction.skycraft.silver_hand.desc: Werewolf hunters turned butchers. They hate the Companions above all and skin what they catch. They take no one in.
faction.skycraft.silver_hand.halls: Forts and ruins across Skyrim: Gallows Rock, Fort Greymoor and others.
faction.skycraft.silver_hand.join: The Silver Hand takes no recruits. They are hunted, not joined.
faction.skycraft.stormcloaks.benefits: Soldiers are armed and armoured by Ulfric's army, train at its forges, buy from its quartermasters for less, and their word carries weight with the guards of the holds Ulfric holds.
faction.skycraft.stormcloaks.halls: The Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.
faction.skycraft.talos_prayer: You pray to Talos. Somewhere, the Thalmor will hear of it.
faction.skycraft.talos_seen: A Thalmor justiciar saw you worship Talos!
faction.skycraft.thalmor.benefits: Agents learn magic and the arts of war from the justiciars, buy arcane goods for less, wear the Thalmor's robes and armour and receive the First Emissary's blade - and guards in Summerset and Valenwood defer to them. Praying to Talos is heresy.
faction.skycraft.thalmor.desc: The ruling party of the Aldmeri Dominion and its secret police. Its justiciars hunt Talos worshippers, Blades and dissidents across Tamriel.
faction.skycraft.thalmor.halls: The Thalmor halls in Alinor; the Thalmor Embassy in Skyrim.
faction.skycraft.thalmor.join: Only the Altmer are trusted: speak with a justiciar in Alinor. Blades and Stormcloaks need not apply.
faction.skycraft.thieves_guild.benefits: Members fence stolen goods, have bounties quietly cleared, train sneak and lockpicking with the doyens, buy from the Guild's fences cheaply and wear the Guild's leathers - and, for the few, the Nightingale's.
faction.skycraft.thieves_guild.halls: The Ragged Flagon under Riften; the Gray Fox's hideout on the Imperial City waterfront.
faction.skycraft.tribunal_temple.benefit: The faithful learn restoration and alchemy from the priests, buy remedies for less, rest at the temples and receive the Temple's robes, Ordinator armour and, at the last, the Patriarch's spear.
faction.skycraft.tribunal_temple.desc: The faith of the Dunmer, raised to the living gods Almalexia, Sotha Sil and Vivec, guarded by its Ordinators and its many pilgrim shrines.
faction.skycraft.tribunal_temple.halls: Temples in Balmora, Ald'ruhn, Necrom and Mournhold; the High Fane of Vivec.
faction.skycraft.tribunal_temple.join: Speak with a priest at the Temple in Balmora, Ald'ruhn, Necrom or Mournhold.
faction.skycraft.undaunted.benefits: Delvers train with weapons and the bow at the enclaves, buy supplies for less, sleep there and earn trophies, a delver's axe and, at the last, a legendary set of ebony.
faction.skycraft.undaunted.desc: A loose brotherhood of delvers who go where others won't for the joy of it and the loot. Their pledges send them into the worst barrows, ruins and tombs of every province.
faction.skycraft.undaunted.halls: Enclaves in Daggerfall, Wayrest, Mournhold, Ebonheart, Elden Root, Firsthold, the Imperial City, Riften, Lilmoth and Rimmen.
faction.skycraft.undaunted.join: Find Glirion the Redbeard at the Undaunted enclave in Daggerfall, or any enclave keeper, and prove you can hold your drink and your nerve.
faction.skycraft.vigilants_of_stendarr.b: Vigilants learn restoration and heavy armour from the Keepers, buy remedies for less, and are given Stendarr's robes, a blessed mace and, at the last, his hammer.
faction.skycraft.vigilants_of_stendarr.d: An order sworn to Stendarr's mercy and his hammer: they hunt Daedra worshippers, vampires and werewolves across Skyrim and confiscate the Princes' artefacts.
faction.skycraft.vigilants_of_stendarr.h: The Hall of the Vigilant in the Pale.
faction.skycraft.vigilants_of_stendarr.j: Speak with a Vigilant at the Hall of the Vigilant, north of Whiterun. They will not take a vampire or a werewolf.
item.skycraft.reward.master_of_the_voice: Robes of the Master of the Voice
